NSCameraUsageDescription: FaceRep uses the front camera as a mirror during workouts and for the face scan. It reads your face movements on the iPhone to show when it sees a move and how far it goes. Nothing is recorded or sent. A scan photo is saved, only on the iPhone, if you turn it on.
NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: FaceRep doesn't use the microphone. The workout mirror shows the camera picture only and never records sound.
